definitions: An emission of a rapid stream of bubbles.
The sound of such an emission.
To make a rapid hissing or bubbling sound.

blocks.text: Effervescence is the escape of gas from an aqueous solution and the foaming or fizzing that results from that release. The word effervescence is derived from the Latin verb fervere, preceded by the prefix ex. It has the same linguistic root as the word fermentation.
